decisions: Identity: the flow drawing's 'second factor' box is not built (Burcu 28 Sep, 8 Oct analysis §2). The customer number comes from the call, and the caller is never asked for a code.

Card selection follows the 8 Oct analysis §3.2 and the 9 Oct recap: name, then last four digits, then last six digits, then the full card number. This replaces the 2 Sep version (full number right after the last four). The documents' 'at most two example names' cannot be enforced exactly. The select node names the eligible cards through <options>.

Cards with isMainCard false (supplementary) are not eligible and are filtered out of the selection (8 Oct §3.3). No eligible card, or the cards.list 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102 warning, leads to the no-eligible-card line and the main menu, not to an agent.

Currency names are always spoken in full (Türk Lirası, Dolar, Euro, İngiliz Sterlini) through currency_words (9 Oct recap point 6, 8 Oct §4.9), including where the dictated sentences say TL/USD. The suffixes 'TL'dir' and 'USD'dir' are dropped because a placeholder cannot carry a suffix.

TL reading cases follow the 8 Oct §4.3 rules. Debt means remainingDebt > 0. Nothing paid: remainingMinPayment > 0 and >= minPayment. Minimum paid: remainingMinPayment <= 0. Less than minimum: remainingMinPayment > 0 and < minPayment. Foreign currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) have one pattern each, read only when remainingDebt > 0.

The no-debt sentence uses all 14 combinations from the 8 Oct §4.5 table. A currency counts as clear when its block exists and remainingDebt <= 0 (negative or zero amounts are never read as debt). A missing block is left out of the sentence (8 Oct, overriding the TBD in 2 Sep).

The no-debt branch is used when the top-level statementPaymentStatus is NO_DEBT or no currency has remainingDebt > 0. It reads the 8 Oct §4.7 sentence; the future-period TL total is read only when > 0 (customer 92311921 has -1896, which is never read). Then it asks about another card or goes to the main menu, with no offer (8 Oct §4.7 and the drawing; Deniz's proposal to offer here was not agreed).

Date-based branches use $today (8 Oct §4.10). Statement cut today: say it is cut tonight at 00.00 and give the total debt. Due date passed: say it has passed and give the total debt, with the auto-payment remainder only when automaticPaymentFlag is Y and the amount is > 0 (§4.6; no line was dictated, so the wording is ours). Due date today: 'bugündür'. Past-due also requires nextLastPayDate >= today so the state is consistent.
The transferAmount line (§4.4) is not built. It is an open point and no sentence was drafted.

contact.email.get runs before the offer (8 Oct §5.2). If it fails, the call goes to an agent with the service-error line (8 Oct §6 and §10; test customer 92335586). Registered e-mail means ibanEmail is non-empty and communicationType is not Phone.

There is no service flag for 'statement week change still allowed', so the week change is always offered. The limit is once per calendar year (Kerem 7 Oct in the 8 Oct analysis). This replaces the IVR sheet's 'ayda bir / yılda üç' and the 2025 website FAQ's 'three times a year'. STW-091/092 are not used because the contract has no such refusal codes.

Statement week wording comes from the 8 Oct analysis §7, not the IVR prompt sheet. Burcu said the IVR prompts are not 'how it should be'. Week numbers are spoken as ordinal words ('birinci haftası') instead of '1.', following Burcu's TTS note. For joint statements, the linked/main card note comes before the confirmation question (8 Oct step 5). The current week cannot be chosen: the caller is told no change is needed and the options are read again.

statement.week.change counts as successful only when result.returnCode is '1', exitState is 'OK' and responseCode is 0 (contract §5.5). The dates read after the change come from the statement.week.decide preview. Any of the three week services failing gives the statement-week agent line.

E-mail is sent only to the registered address (Selin Q3, 8 Oct §6), so the website FAQ's 'any address you give us' is overridden. Only the last cut statement can be sent (statementDate from cards.balance). currencyType is sent as 'TL' because the documents do not say which currency's PDF to send. The address is read from ttsEmail. The rule for shortening long addresses cannot be implemented without data, so the address is read as given.
After a successful send the call goes to the main menu (8 Oct §6 step 4), so the 'up to three resends' case cannot occur in this flow.

Out-of-scope questions follow the 9 Oct recap, which is later than the 8 Oct direct hand-off: the assistant first asks 'Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarmamı ister misiniz?'. Yes goes to the main menu. No resumes the question the caller was on, using a 'stage' variable set before each question.

Angry caller: up to three calming replies, then an agent on the fourth complaint (Selin's 9 Oct correction of 'two'). This is counted with calm1/calm2/calm3 and the flow resumes where it was. The assistant never answers insults.

Silence: the documents want two short re-asks and then 'Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.' (8 Oct §8.2). The flow has no separate silence hook, so silence uses the runtime re-ask (max_reasks 2). When re-asks run out, the call goes to on_unclear with the three-tries line from 8 Oct §8.1.

Main-menu wording is 'Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.' (8 Oct §8.4). 'Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.' is used where the documents dictate it: no eligible card, three tries used up, non-Turkish speaker.
Third-party requests end with a security line and the call goes back to the IVR login step, with no information about the other person's cards (Burcu Q8, 8 Oct §8.6).

Payment requests and how-to-pay questions go to an agent (Kerem Q2). The website FAQ's payment-channel answers are not used. The FAQ answers kept as globals are only those not contradicted by later bank decisions.

Only-one-figure requests and cutting in during the reading are not modelled separately; the full reading is always given. A caller who asks for e-mail at the 'another card' question goes straight to the address confirmation without the offer.

The OAuth token operation is not called. The test environment does not check tokens and no client credentials are in the documents. call.ani is not available as a call variable, so only call.lang 'tr' is sent; the test environment ignores call metadata.

assistant_self: the documents never give the assistant a name, so it introduces itself as 'Freya Bank sesli asistanı'. The opening includes 'Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.' because the first step is a service call.
